not_a_claim: This reference does not claim that Scramble or any other reviewed provider implements these controls. Provider conformance requires provider-owned evidence that passes every acceptance check.
applies_to: Recurring agent payments for one payable API, MCP, tool, data, or service capability.

field_rules.amounts: Use integer minor units and declare the asset and its decimals in the limit policy.
field_rules.periodic_limit: window_type is fixed or rolling. The provider declares the exact duration, boundaries and usage before and after each request.
field_rules.idempotency: The key scope must include the payer or agent subject and capability. The same key and request hash is a replay; the same key with a different request hash is a conflict.
field_rules.receipt_identity: receipt_id is immutable for one accepted intent and remains stable in every replay and status read.
field_rules.finality: status is pending until the declared confirmation_depth or rpc_finalized rule is satisfied on the canonical chain.
field_rules.reorg: An orphaned pre-finality observation invalidates the prior settlement proof, blocks fulfillment and revenue recognition, and never authorizes an automatic second charge.

acceptance_checks.pass_condition: Accepted charges keep usage_after_minor at or below amount_limit_minor in the declared window. The first over-limit request is rejected without a charge or settlement and returns the same window end as retry_after.
Repeating the same idempotency_key and request_hash returns the original receipt_id, payment_reference and tx_hash, with exactly one settlement.
Reusing an idempotency_key with a different request_hash returns idempotency_conflict and creates no charge, receipt or settlement.
The initial accepted response, every replay, and every status read return one unchanged receipt_id for the intent.
The receipt remains pending before the declared finality rule is met and becomes finalized only when its transaction and block identity are still canonical and the rule is satisfied.

If the observed block is orphaned before finality, the receipt moves to reorg_detected or reconciliation_required, prior settlement proof cannot unlock fulfillment or revenue, no automatic second charge occurs, and any replacement transaction is linked by reconciliation_id.

publication_rule: Publish provider conformance only after all six checks pass against provider-owned test or production evidence. A free snapshot may cite this artifact only as a remediation reference.
